script: Eleven leaders left OpenAI in months.

instagram.caption:
Eleven leaders have left OpenAI in just months, and every single exit traces back to one fight: how fast models ship versus how safe they are.

That dispute now decides which models actually reach you. More safety-focused leaders leave, and the pace of releases speeds up. Each departure shifts the balance further.

If you create content or build tools on OpenAI models, the trade-off isn't abstract anymore—you're getting faster outputs, but the people who argued for guardrails are gone.

So here's the real question: when you pick a model to build on, do you check who was still in the room when it shipped? 🧭⚖️🚪
